version.changelog: First registry publication of the received installed continuation entry.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed EIN.LLC continuation helper that fetches a pinned archive and uses caller-supplied files, with safeguards against payment, filing, and claim actions.

dimensions.detail: Node 22, outbound access to ein.llc or explicit loopback, and reads of customer key/context/grant files are sensitive but disclosed and proportionate to the continuation workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill acquires executable code from ein.llc at runtime, but the archive, descriptor, members, sizes, modes, and hashes are pinned and verified before import; no npm install is used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are specific to acquire/run commands and named caller-owned files; no prompt hijacking, hidden role changes, or unrelated agent instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to the caller-chosen work directory and continuation state file; no background service, startup hook, broad indexing, or privilege escalation was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, commands, network destinations, file inputs, and no-spend boundaries are coherent and match the wrapper script behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use EIN.LLC's continuation workflow and are comfortable providing the named context, customer key, email, grant, and state files to that flow. Keep the work directory and state file private, and do not use this as authority to claim, pay, attest, register, or file on behalf of a human.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the local script and pin file were present and inspected; the remaining acquired archive is a disclosed, hash-pinned part of the skill's purpose rather than hidden analysis evasion.
[LP3] expected: Network access and named local file reads are expected for this workflow and described in the skill, though explicit permission metadata would make enforcement clearer.
[SQP-3] unexpected: The wrapper sets LANG=C for the invoked client; this is not a security-relevant expansion of authority, but preserving or documenting locale behavior would be better.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The pin manifest alone has sparse activation wording, but the SKILL.md name and description give a narrow EIN.LLC continuation scope.
